correctness.rationale: The total velocity v=1+f, not the modulation f, is positive. Integrating it over any full period gives distance 2π, so full cycles add phase-independent time and it suffices to treat 0<r<2π. The phase derivative of the inverse travel time vanishes only at equal endpoint velocities; evenness and strict half-period monotonicity force the endpoints to be reflections. Each centered arc gives a strictly monotone length map r=s±2F(s/2), with one root in (0,2π). The roots lie on opposite sides of r, so their unique phases provide the global minimum and maximum. An independent check of the global comparison is to set a=s_fast/2 and b=s_slow/2. Then W′(r)=1/(1−f(b))−1/(1+f(a)), with sign equal to the sign of f(a)+f(b)=f(a)−f(π−b). This changes strictly from positive to negative when the increasing sum a+b crosses π, which occurs at r=π since F(π−a)=F(a). At r=π, the root satisfies δ=π/2−a=F(a), a unique root by the monotone branch equation; the width is 4δ. At a full cycle, ∂ℓT=1/v at release phase and the second derivative is uniformly bounded by sup|v′|/(1−c)³. Taking the range in the uniform expansion gives the stated two-sided linear cusp. Physical units multiply spacing by U/ω and time spread by 1/ω.
residual_risks: Finite spot checks support numerical examples, not all admissible waveforms. The assumptions exclude diffusion, reversal, and nonuniform spatial velocity.

Prior phase-dependent residence-time work is not claimed as new. The closest inspected catalogue statements treat other observables or transport regimes; neither directly gives this variational result. value.rationale: For a natural idealized time-dependent transport problem, the result answers a gauge-placement question independently of waveform details while making the maximum spread explicitly waveform-sensitive. The unique phase extrema away from whole periods and the exact linear rate at which timing information disappears at resonance provide useful exact benchmarks beyond the observation that timing matters.
residual_risks: This is a deterministic plug-flow benchmark, not a validated field prescription for tidal or turbulent channels.
